prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. ONE woman, facing the camera straight on in a perfectly frontal portrait, her head level, both ears clearly visible on either side of her face, framed tightly from the very top of her head down to the line of her shoulders, the frame cutting off just below them, so the long earrings fully hang in view. Her face is large and sharp. Mid 40s.

Subject: A real photograph of a striking adult Korean woman — Korean poised refined beauty fair complexion with a neutral-rose undertone and natural skin tone, mid 40s, a polished silver low bun with a few loose strands, smudged black raccoon eyeliner ringing the eyes, jagged black eyeshadow shards at the outer corners, thick black lower lashes, thin bleached brows, glossy black lips with a deliberately ragged edge, vivid neon lime-green coloured contact lenses with a thick dark outer ring and round natural pupils, both eyes the same, fully opaque and solidly saturated across the whole iris with no natural brown showing through, the colour bright and unmistakable, with a darker limbal ring, sitting naturally on the irises and clear of the eyelids, a piercing direct stare, jaw set, lips firmly closed, a bold, commanding, fierce expression — a photograph of a real Korean woman's face, not an illustration, not a render. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living skin with visible pores and faint peach-fuzz hairs, slightly asymmetrical with a few small natural beauty marks and freckles, never airbrushed and never smooth like plastic, real wet catchlights in the eyes, individual hair strands catching the light. Her face has been surgically sculpted far beyond her natural look, and these changes override her natural features: her eyes are the star of her face (the shape, size and lenses described here override the eyes of her makeup, while the colours of her eyeshadow and liner follow her makeup): very large, perfectly round doll eyes, clearly bigger than normal but still a real human eye on a real face: a big visible iris in vivid coloured big-iris contact lenses with a round natural pupil, both eyes the same, bright catchlights and real moist reflections, a darker limbal ring and a lighter coloured gradient at the bottom of the iris, long thick curled real lashes with a few lower lashes, and soft natural brows; her nose: a refined nose; her jawline and chin: an extreme, razor-sharp V-line: the cheeks taper in a long, smooth, straight diagonal from the ears down to a small, narrow, pointed chin, a very slim lower face with a sharply defined sculpted jaw edge. Every feature is exaggerated but beautiful, balanced and refined, in harmony with the rest of her face, never distorted, never grotesque.

Piercings: A face fully covered with real piercings, about one hundred and fifty-nine in total (not counting the hanging drops), spread over every area so that no area is empty: three separate septum rings of different sizes and shapes through the thin soft wall between the nostrils, in a short stack that ends above the upper lip; four small rings wrapping snugly around each nostril wing; ten small hoop or studs along the edge of the upper lip; sixteen small hoop or studs across the lower lip's edge; ten small ring or studs on the chin; on each ear, two separate large healed openings in the earlobe, one below the other with a clear gap of bare skin between them, the lower opening holding an enormous oval hoop earring almost the size of her palm, thick polished metal set with a continuous line of gems, with a long drop of three graduated teardrop gems hanging freely in the air from its base down to the level of her collarbone and no lower, and the upper opening holding a large classic round hoop earring, and above them sit twenty-nine pieces above the lobe: fourteen classic round O-rings and studs along the helix rim, nine studs and small bars across the upper cartilage and six in the conch and tragus; twenty small studs across the lower half of the forehead just above the brows in even rows, leaving the upper forehead free; sixteen small studs along each cheekbone, well clear of the eyes. The pieces on her face are punk in style: instead of plain studs and rings, the small pieces are safety-pin shaped bars, sharp cone-spike studs and chunky chain-link rings. The left and right sides are balanced. The piercings are packed so densely that the rows touch and overlap, leaving only hairline gaps of bare skin between them, until the face reads as a single armour of metal; the eyes and eyelids stay clear. Henna: fine metallic gold henna mehndi line patterns of vines and dots are painted across the upper forehead near the hairline only, above the forehead studs, well clear of the eyes and brows. The face and ear jewelry is real blackened steel and chrome silver, spiked and studded, with no gemstones, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Hair: her hair is swept back behind both ears, leaving both ears, her jawline and her neck fully visible so every hanging piece is in clear view.

Lighting: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. A soft frontal light on her face and ears, so the glints on every piece of metal read clearly against her skin; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
